personality_one_liner: A sacred, calm, and respectful digital space evoking the peace of a temple at dawn, using cinematic depth and glowing marigold accents over deep indigo night.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for a calm, editorial feel. Use md for inner padding and xl for outer screen padding to give the sacred content space.

do's: Use blur/glass on bottom sheet headers and sticky headers over scrolling content.
Use frosted glass over the starry night background for featured Tithi cards.
Ensure readability by adding a ≥75% surfaceSecondary tint underneath text on glass.
dont's: Don't apply glass to every single list row or form input.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Displays today's Tithi, Nakshatra, Sunrise, and current active alarms over a calming animated background.

states.empty: No upcoming alarms. Show a serene illustration or text prompting to add a sacred alarm.
states.error: Unable to fetch Panchang data. Show localized location-error state and a retry button.

screens.layout: Root container has a background image (starry night) + Reanimated floating Om layer. Overlaid is a Glass-morphism card showing Today's Tithi & significance (Serif font for Tithi name). Below it, a list of scheduled alarms. Bottom sticky CTA to 'Add Alarm'.

screens.name: AlarmSetup
screens.purpose: Allows users to schedule an alarm, choose the chant sound (Om/Bell), and toggle location.
screens.layout: Bottom sheet or full modal. Elegant time picker, segmented controls for Sound (Om Chant, Temple Bell, Custom). Location toggle for accurate local Panchang. Sticky 'Save' button at bottom.

background_night_sky.alt: Dark indigo night sky with stars, representing dawn/temple atmosphere

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: Deep Indigo night background with Marigold/Saffron text and glowing highlights. Do NOT use standard purple/indigo generic AI themes.

Implement the 'Floating Om animation background' using `react-native-reanimated`. Render the Om (ॐ) character in a large serif font, slowly translating (floating up/down) and gently scaling/fading (opacity 5%-15%) in the absolute background.

For the Tithi cards, use `expo-blur` to create a cinematic frosted glass effect over the background night sky image. Apply the required gradient scrim (top to bottom) if placing text directly over the image.
Use Cormorant Garamond (or another elegant serif) for all spiritual terms (Ekadashi, Tithi names, Om) to evoke reverence and tradition.
Ensure 'Today's Panchang' details (Nakshatra, Sunrise) are displayed cleanly in the secondary Sans-Serif font for high legibility.
Avoid all default blue colors, replace with the Marigold (#F59E0B) or Gold (#FCD34D) accents from the palette.
